chemistry_notes: Knoevenagel condensation using heterogeneous N-doped carbon base. Batch time is 24h, suggesting slow kinetics or mass transfer limits. Flow design uses a packed bed reactor (PBR) to maximize catalyst contact. Residence time reduced to 144 min (2.4h) based on 10x intensification factor from calculations, significantly faster than batch. Temperature maintained at 50°C. No BPR required as T < bp-20°C. Single liquid stream fed into PBR.

Given the heterogeneous nature and 50°C requirement, 144 min is a conservative starting point for optimization.
